changeSet.author: archiv
changeSet.sql: create table mandant_bericht ( monat date not null constraint mandant_bericht_pk primary key check (extract(day from monat) = 1), speicher_bytes bigint not null constraint mandant_bericht_speicher_ck check (speicher_bytes >= 0), dokumente jsonb not null constraint mandant_bericht_dokumente_ck check (jsonb_typeof(dokumente) = 'object'), ki_tokens jsonb not null constraint mandant_bericht_tokens_ck check (jsonb_typeof(ki_tokens) = 'object'), chat_fragen bigint not null constraint mandant_bericht_chat_fragen_ck check (chat_fragen >= 0), mail_versandt boolean not null default false, erstellt timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp() );
